description: NaTh₃F₁₃ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃/mmc space group. Na is bonded to four F atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaF₄ trigonal pyramids. There is one shorter (2.02 Å) and three longer (2.56 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Th is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Th-F bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.64 Å. There are seven inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Na atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Th atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Th atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Th atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent Th atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Th atoms. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent Th atoms.
